verdict.rationale: Docs confirm ingestion of 'text, files, or URLs' via a single call (docs-16) and that `.remember`/`.recall` handle storage and retrieval of that content later (docs-1, docs-37), which covers the general 'files as memory inputs' claim, but no evidence explicitly confirms image or PDF parsing/support specifically, nor any hands-on example of recalling from a PDF/image. missing for 10: explicit documentation or example of PDF/image ingestion, independent verification that non-text file types are correctly parsed and recalled.
